messages:
maria: Heads-up: schedule for the user_email_flags schema change is Thursday 23:30 UTC. Needs a short quiesce window and a graceful rollback plan.

sam-db: Thanks — plan is non-blocking ghost-table+swap, small backfill job, then a feature-flag flip. Expect ~45m wall time but we can gate with a quiesce.

jon: Is the backfill CPU-bound or IO-bound? Any risk of pushing DB I/O to high P99?

sam-db: Mostly IO. Backfill reads 1.2M rows; we have a window estimate: ~15 rows/s per pod under current load. We'll shard the job and throttle concurrency.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: migration:user_email_flags:1729999999 by sam-db at 2024-11-14T23:30:00Z. React with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge. (canary=1, parallel=3)

ops: Please pin web/service to v2.14.1 on that window so no schema drift. If we need to rollback, we'll revert code first.

emily: Confirming: pinting all frontend and api pods to v2.14.1 for the 1h window. I'll push the k8s image pin at T-20m.

sam-db: Rollback criteria (draft):
- migration job error rate > 2% for any shard in 5m window
- DB lock wait > 250ms sustained > 2m
- replicas lag > 30s for more than 3 replicas
If hit, pause backfill and revert service pin.

maria: Add a manual holdpoint at the swap step. We do swap only after production smoke checks (tokenized send + a few reads).

jon: Can we set a deploybot hold flag so automated canaries stop before swap? Something like:
```
deploybot hold --thread 1729999999 --step swap
```

deploybot: command accepted — holdpoint registered at step: swap. Canary will pause and notify #eng-releases.

sam-db: Backfill config (short):
```
-- shard-count=8
-- max-concurrency=4
-- read-batch=500
-- sleep-ms=200
```
This should keep I/O under the safe cap.

ops: Also schedule a lightweight traffic-dampen via ingress 50% -> 20% for 10m around swap to reduce burst risk. I'll prepare the helm patch.

sre-bot: Alert runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-backfill-ops (auto-post).

emily: Quick note: release notes will mention the flag name email_flags_v2, targetting backend clients that rely on legacy payloads. I'll draft and circulate.

maria: Last check — who will own the rollback if we hit the criteria?

sam-db: I'll own DB rollback (pause + data fix if needed). Ops will handle service pin revert. Maria to coordinate comms.

jon: On-call question: if replicas lag spikes, do we abort swap or only backfill?

sre-bot: Recommendation: abort swap, pause backfill, and escalate to DB oncall for replica recovery.

maria: Cool. T-30m I'll post the final checklist in this thread and tag ops/oncall. Everyone react when you get the T-5min notice. :thumbsup:

emily: Reacted. Preparing release note blurb now.

deploybot: migration:user_email_flags:1729999999 started (canary 1/3). Logs: /deploys/1729999999/logs

sam-db: Canary backfill running, shard 0 healthy. Throughput ~16 rows/s. No locks.

maria: Initiating smoke checks after canary shard success. Posting results in 5.

maria: Smoke checks: send/receive + read path ok, no increase in p99. Proceeding to scheduled swap holdpoint.

deploybot: swap step reached — HOLD engaged. Awaiting manual approval to continue.

ops: Ingress dampen applied. Traffic down to 25%.

jon: Observability: p99 tail steady, replication lag 3s. Good to proceed if everyone ok.

maria: Approve swap.

deploybot: swap performed. migration:user_email_flags:1729999999 complete. Canary -> next two shards rolling.

sam-db: Rolling shards 1..7 now. Rate cap active. Monitoring closely.

emily: Draft release note (for internal): "Email flags column type migration completed. Feature flag email_flags_v2 available for progressive rollout. No user-facing changes expected." Will post external note tomorrow.

maria: Closing thread after post-mortem check at +1h. Thanks everyone. :tada:
